title: One structured mock fits in twenty-five minutes
takeaway: A fixed four-part mock, scored on a short rubric, lets a whole batch be tested on the same things.
sources: A mock for a final-year engineering student can fit in twenty-five minutes:
A mock is only useful if two students who sat it can compare notes and find they were tested on the same things.
